title: Import Project
description: Audit and import another laboratory's real microscopy images, masks, and measurements into a provenance-preserving spaCR project.
objectives: Pair external multichannel images with cell, nucleus, pathogen, and organelle label masks.
Preview joins, units, conflicts, and editable column mappings without writing data.
Save the reviewed mapping and create a traceable spaCR project in a new destination.
prerequisite: External microscopy images, one label-mask folder per available object class, and a CSV, TSV, Excel, Parquet, or SQLite measurement table.

scenes.narration: Import Project brings another laboratory's images, label masks, and measurements into a spaCR project without treating an inferred mapping as truth. Open it from Data and batch runs. The upper controls describe their inputs, the middle is an editable review, and the lower controls save that decision or start the separate import.
scenes.speech_text: Import Project brings another laboratory's images, label masks, and measurements into a spacer project without treating an inferred mapping as truth. Open it from Data and batch runs. The upper controls describe their inputs, the middle is an editable review, and the lower controls save that decision or start the separate import.

scenes.narration: Choose or drop the external image folder and select a new destination. This lesson uses two real 2000-by-2000 fields, each with four fluorescence channels. The source spaCR arrays were decoded into neutral TIFF inputs only for the cross-tool import demonstration; no synthetic pixels were created.
scenes.speech_text: Choose or drop the external image folder and select a new destination. This lesson uses two real two thousand by two thousand fields, each with four fluorescence channels. The source spacer arrays were decoded into neutral T I F F inputs only for the cross tool import demonstration; no synthetic pixels were created.

scenes.narration: A merged spaCR field can carry one label plane for each object class. Select a class, choose its folder, and click Add. Repeat for cell, nucleus, pathogen, and organelle masks. Every field must have every declared class; unmatched image or mask files are listed rather than guessed.
scenes.speech_text: A merged spacer field can carry one label plane for each object class. Select a class, choose its folder, and click Add. Repeat for cell, nucleus, pathogen, and organelle masks. Every field must have every declared class; unmatched image or mask files are listed rather than guessed.

scenes.narration: Add the real measurement CSV and declare 0.65 micrometres per pixel so square-micrometre areas can be converted correctly. The table intentionally contains a column named cell_area. Rename to the foreign prefix preserves that external value without silently replacing a spaCR feature. The original files remain read-only, and output goes to the new destination.
scenes.speech_text: Add the real measurement C S V and declare zero point six five micrometres per pixel so square micrometre areas can be converted correctly. The table intentionally contains a column named cell area. Rename to the foreign prefix preserves that external value without silently replacing a spacer feature. The original files remain read only, and output goes to the new destination.

scenes.narration: Click Preview before importing. Preview scans the image headers, pairs every mask by field, reads the measurement table, checks object labels, proposes column mappings, resolves units and name conflicts, and writes nothing.
scenes.speech_text: Click Preview before importing. Preview scans the image headers, pairs every mask by field, reads the measurement table, checks object labels, proposes column mappings, resolves units and name conflicts, and writes nothing.

scenes.narration: The two fields are ready. The editable table shows each external column, proposed spaCR target, transform, input and output units, and a review note. The report confirms that 206 of 207 measurement rows match real cell labels. One absent label and 1,198 mask objects without table rows are disclosed, never silently discarded or invented.
scenes.speech_text: The two fields are ready. The editable table shows each external column, proposed spacer target, transform, input and output units, and a review note. The report confirms that two hundred six of two hundred seven measurement rows match real cell labels. One absent label and one thousand one hundred ninety eight mask objects without table rows are disclosed, never silently discarded or invented.

scenes.narration: The proposal is deliberately editable. Select the spaCR-column cell for AreaShape_Area_um2 and replace the target with a reviewed, meaningful name. Transform and unit columns may also be corrected here; every edit immediately re-runs collision and calibration checks without rescanning the folders.
scenes.speech_text: The proposal is deliberately editable. Select the spacer column cell for Area Shape Area micrometres squared and replace the target with a reviewed, meaningful name. Transform and unit columns may also be corrected here; every edit immediately re-runs collision and calibration checks without rescanning the folders.

scenes.narration: The area target is now foreign_reviewed_cell_area. Its area transform remains calibrated from square micrometres to square pixels, while the conflicting external cell_area is separately renamed with the foreign prefix. The status still says nothing has been written.
scenes.speech_text: The area target is now foreign reviewed cell area. Its area transform remains calibrated from square micrometres to square pixels, while the conflicting external cell area is separately renamed with the foreign prefix. The status still says nothing has been written.

scenes.narration: Click Save mapping to write the complete review as CSV. The file can be inspected, versioned, shared with a collaborator, edited outside the application, and loaded again. Import will apply exactly the mapping shown on screen.
scenes.speech_text: Click Save mapping to write the complete review as C S V. The file can be inspected, versioned, shared with a collaborator, edited outside the application, and loaded again. Import will apply exactly the mapping shown on screen.

scenes.narration: The reviewed mapping is saved beside the isolated tutorial output. Load mapping restores the same decisions later. The destination must be new or belong to the same experiment; Import Project refuses a destination containing measurements from different fields before writing a file.
scenes.speech_text: The reviewed mapping is saved beside the isolated tutorial output. Load mapping restores the same decisions later. The destination must be new or belong to the same experiment; Import Project refuses a destination containing measurements from different fields before writing a file.

scenes.narration: After reviewing the images, four mask classes, join report, units, conflicts, and destination, click Import. This separate action converts image names, writes intensity and mask stacks, builds merged arrays with spaCR's native plane order, and creates the database and provenance records.
scenes.speech_text: After reviewing the images, four mask classes, join report, units, conflicts, and destination, click Import. This separate action converts image names, writes intensity and mask stacks, builds merged arrays with spacer's native plane order, and creates the database and provenance records.

scenes.narration: The import completes with two fields, eight converted channel TIFFs, eight mask arrays, and two merged arrays containing four intensity planes followed by cell, nucleus, pathogen, and organelle labels. All 207 external rows are preserved in foreign_cell and a canonical convenience copy, while measurements.db and the applied mapping record which columns came from outside spaCR.
scenes.speech_text: The import completes with two fields, eight converted channel T I F F files, eight mask arrays, and two merged arrays containing four intensity planes followed by cell, nucleus, pathogen, and organelle labels. All two hundred seven external rows are preserved in foreign cell and a canonical convenience copy, while measurements dot D B and the applied mapping record which columns came from outside spacer.
